name: media
title: Now Playing
description: What is playing in Spotify, Music, a browser or any MPRIS player: play, pause, skip.
author: pal

settings.label: Cover on the bar
settings.text: Show the cover instead of the note on the menu bar strip
settings.description: Only a square cover; a 24 pt picture of anything else is a smudge. The popover shows the cover either way.

settings.label: Leave to another extension
settings.description: Players this extension leaves to another (the Spotify extension's own item, say), by app name (Spotify, Music, Google Chrome) or player id (spotify, music, system): the bar item and the root's Now row skip them; the palette still lists them.

media.description: One row per player with the track and its artwork.

keys.title: Open the track in its player

state.description: The strip's player: playing, paused, stopped, or none

now-playing.title: Now Playing
now-playing.description: The playing track on the strip; a paused player is hidden by its rule (keep it on the strip, muted, by turning that rule's Hidden off), nothing running is hidden either way. The popover shows the cover, the track, a progress bar that ticks and the transport as keys. Re-rendered the moment the track changes (macOS).

artwork.title: The cover as the icon (Cover on the bar)

paused.title: Paused, kept on the bar (While a player runs)

keys.title: Open the track in its player (cmd+o too)

rules.description: A player that is not playing: off the strip, muted for anyone who keeps it.

store.tagline: Play, pause and skip Spotify, Music, a browser or any MPRIS player
features: One row per running player: the track, artist and album, the cover, `12:34 / 1:06:03`, a `playing` / `paused` / `stopped` tag
macOS: every player the system's Now Playing sees (a browser, VLC), through the bundled MediaRemote adapter, on macOS 15.4 and later too; a track change reaches the bar the moment it happens
`enter` plays or pauses and the tag follows; `cmd+right` and `cmd+left` skip
`cmd+c` copies `artist - title`; `cmd+o` opens the track (Spotify's `spotify:track:` link) or the app
Live: the current track is a root result, so its title or artist finds it without opening the palette

A bar item with the playing track; its popover shows the cover large, the track, a progress bar ticking every second and the transport as keys, refreshed the moment a track changes (macOS) or within seconds (Linux)
